title: T2s Phase Run Summary
description: The research lead's evaluative summary of a phase run (system_artifact_types.md): serves the lead's own later synthesis AND the user's 'Read more details' UI panel. Lead-authored only. Total serialized size must stay under 32768 bytes (runtime-enforced hard cap).

evaluation_markdown.description: Explain what was established, its support and decisive limitation, and what subsequent work may rely on. For a P5 revision, state substantive changes with review issue references, preserve unresolved criticism, and distinguish the reviewed draft from the lead-checked revision. Interpret the supported result and practical boundary for the researcher objective without rewriting audited statements, quantifiers, assumptions or proof support for brevity. For P3 next-work recommendations, keep proposed next work a conditional recommendation within the stated scope. Recommend what to prioritize if its conditions hold; do not turn that recommendation into an instruction to start or imply authorization for another run.

method_scores.description: Optional per-method scoring matrix (UI-facing only, mirrored from the decision record per D11).
